skin_care.description: A gentle hydrating face wash designed to remove dirt, excess oil, and impurities without drying the skin.
skin_care.how_to_use: Wet your face, apply a small amount of face wash, gently massage for 30-60 seconds, and rinse thoroughly. Use twice daily.

skin_care.description: A lightweight facial serum formulated for oily and acne-prone skin to help manage breakouts and excess sebum.
skin_care.how_to_use: Apply 2-3 drops to clean, dry skin once daily. Start with alternate-day usage if your skin is sensitive.
benefits: Helps reduce the appearance of breakouts

skin_care.description: A brightening facial serum designed to improve the appearance of dull and uneven-looking skin.
skin_care.how_to_use: Apply 2-3 drops to cleansed skin in the morning. Follow with moisturizer and sunscreen.
benefits: Helps brighten the appearance of skin

skin_care.description: A rich yet lightweight moisturizer designed to provide long-lasting hydration for dry and dehydrated skin.
skin_care.how_to_use: Apply a small amount to the face and neck after cleansing. Use morning and evening.
benefits: Helps strengthen the skin moisture barrier

skin_care.description: A lightweight broad-spectrum sunscreen designed for daily protection against UVA and UVB exposure.
skin_care.how_to_use: Apply generously to the face, neck, and exposed areas 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2-3 hours when outdoors.
problems_it_solves: Uneven-looking skin tone caused by sun exposure
benefits: Helps protect against UVA and UVB rays

hair_care.description: A cleansing shampoo designed to remove flakes and excess oil while keeping the scalp feeling fresh.
hair_care.how_to_use: Apply to wet hair and scalp. Massage gently for 1-2 minutes and rinse thoroughly. Use 2-3 times per week.

hair_care.description: A lightweight scalp serum designed to support healthier-looking hair and improve the appearance of weak, thinning areas.
hair_care.how_to_use: Apply a few drops directly to the scalp and gently massage with fingertips. Use once daily.
benefits: Helps improve the appearance of hair density

hair_care.description: A smoothing conditioner formulated to help moisturize dry and damaged-looking hair and improve manageability.
hair_care.how_to_use: After shampooing, apply from mid-length to ends. Leave for 2-3 minutes and rinse thoroughly.
benefits: Helps reduce the appearance of frizz

hair_care.description: A deep-conditioning hair mask designed for dry, rough, and frizzy hair.
hair_care.how_to_use: Apply generously to clean, damp hair from mid-length to ends. Leave for 5-10 minutes and rinse. Use 1-2 times per week.
benefits: Leaves hair softer and more manageable

hair_care.description: A nourishing hair oil blend designed to condition dry hair and improve softness and shine.
hair_care.how_to_use: Apply a small amount to the scalp and hair lengths. Massage gently and leave for 30-60 minutes before shampooing.
benefits: Helps reduce the feeling of dryness

body_care.description: A daily moisturizing body lotion designed to hydrate and soften dry skin.
body_care.how_to_use: Apply generously to clean, dry skin, preferably immediately after bathing. Use daily.

body_care.description: A refreshing body wash designed to cleanse sweat, dirt, and excess oil while leaving the skin feeling fresh.
body_care.how_to_use: Apply to wet skin using your hands, loofah, or bath sponge. Massage gently and rinse thoroughly.

body_care.description: A gentle exfoliating body scrub designed to remove dead skin cells and improve the appearance of rough skin.
body_care.how_to_use: Apply to damp skin and gently massage in circular motions for 1-2 minutes. Rinse thoroughly. Use 1-2 times per week.
benefits: Helps improve the appearance of skin texture

body_care.description: A daily deodorant roll-on designed to help control underarm odor and provide a fresh feeling throughout the day.
body_care.how_to_use: Apply to clean, dry underarms. Allow the product to dry before dressing.

body_care.description: A rich foot cream designed to moisturize dry feet and soften rough heels.
body_care.how_to_use: Apply generously to clean, dry feet, focusing on heels and other dry areas. Use once or twice daily.
benefits: Improves the appearance of dry feet
